name: Assets Mining on Ground Feature Plane
aliases: Feature Plane Segmentation for Object Extraction
definition: A process to extract individual object representations from a learned ground feature plane by segmenting it into clusters and detecting contours to obtain bounding boxes and enclosed feature patches.
summary: Assets Mining on Ground Feature Plane is an unsupervised post-processing technique that extracts individual object representations from a learned ground feature plane by segmenting the 2D density plane into clusters and detecting contours to obtain bounding boxes and enclosed feature patches.
